rv.q: Ms. Houdyshell's performance as Ann Kron retains an anchoring authenticity that guarantees that 'Well' opens doors of insight and emotion that no other play in New York is unlocking right now.

tn.cat: Best Featured Actress in a Play

cn.t: Critics praise Lisa Kron's sparkling autobiographical play for restoring honor to the memoir genre, though some find its ambitions don't quite coalesce into a neat whole.
